// Per-product logo attributes, included by the document header (same structure as the
// per-product logo files of the CNA documentation toolchain). The Keyple Demo Ticketing has no
// product logo of its own: the Calypso logo is used on the title page and in the HTML header.
// (No blank lines: this file is spliced into the document header.)
// Logo as a self-contained SVG data URI, generated from logos/calypso.svg.
// Consumed by docinfo.html:  background-image: url("{logo-product-datauri}")
:logo-product-datauri: data:image/svg+xml;base64,
// PDF title-page logo -- reuses the data URI above so the PDF stays self-contained.
:title-logo-image: image:{logo-product-datauri}[pdfwidth=2.0in]
